name: Pork & Veggie Bibimbap
desc: Jasmine rice bowls with ginger-garlic ground pork, sautéed carrot ribbons, cucumber, quick-pickled scallions, a fried egg, and a sweet sriracha sauce.

source.title: Pork & Veggie Bibimbap with Carrots & Pickled Scallions
source.evidence: Same amounts of jasmine rice, vinegar, sesame oil, sriracha, soy sauce, ground pork, and sugar, with the same pickled scallion whites and sauce; this version swaps HelloFresh's sautéed zucchini for raw cucumber, uses rice vinegar for white wine vinegar, and adds fried eggs.

ingredients.raw: 1 thumb-size piece fresh ginger, peeled and minced
2 scallions, thinly sliced, whites and greens separated
ingredients.prep: thinly sliced, whites and greens separated

ingredients.raw: Kosher salt and black pepper, to taste

steps: Combine the rice, 1 1/4 cups water, and a big pinch of salt in a small pot. Bring to a boil, cover, reduce to a low simmer, and cook until tender, 15-18 min. Keep covered off the heat until serving.
Meanwhile, trim and peel the carrots, then shave them lengthwise into ribbons with a vegetable peeler, rotating as you go; discard the cores.
Pickle: combine the scallion whites, vinegar, and a pinch of salt in a small bowl. Set aside, stirring now and then.
Sauce: in another small bowl, stir the sesame oil, 1 tbsp of the soy sauce, the sugar, and up to half the sriracha until the sugar dissolves.
Heat a drizzle of the cooking oil in a large nonstick pan over medium-high heat. Add the carrot ribbons, season with salt and pepper, and cook, stirring, until slightly softened, 3-4 min. Set aside.

Add another drizzle of oil and the pork, ginger, and garlic. Cook, breaking up the meat, until browned and cooked through (160°F), 4-6 min. Add the remaining 1 tbsp soy sauce and cook until the liquid has mostly evaporated, 1-2 min. Season with salt and pepper and move to a plate.
Wipe out the pan, add the last of the oil over medium heat, and fry the eggs until the whites are set and the yolks still runny, 2-3 min.

Fluff the rice, season lightly, and divide between bowls. Arrange the pork, carrots, and cucumber on top, then a fried egg. Spoon over the pickled scallion whites with their liquid, drizzle with the sauce and remaining sriracha to taste, and scatter the scallion greens.
tips: HelloFresh's version browns 1 zucchini (half-moons, 3-5 min per side) in place of the raw cucumber; either works.
